name: Schedule and Sheet Diff
description: Compare the sheet list, sheet revisions and schedule rows between two saved snapshots: sheets added, removed, renumbered, renamed or moved in the numbering order, revision fields that changed, and schedule rows added, removed, changed or moved. A block the snapshot does not hold is reported as not captured, never as no change. Optional CSV or Excel export in the workspace. Read-only.
author: AEC Model Bridge

commands.title: Schedule and Sheet Diff Between Snapshots

older_snapshot_id.description: Snapshot id of the earlier issue.

newer_snapshot_id.description: Snapshot id of the later issue.

max_items.description: Most rows listed per section; counts are always complete. The export holds every row.

export_filename.description: Optional .csv or .xlsx file name inside the workspace with every difference, one row each.
